name: FEMTO 轴承退化相似性 RUL（趋势级）

evaluation.note: 3 holdout trials x 5 prediction points; extrapolation fails on abrupt failures (MAE 220.9)

limitations: failure-threshold HI varies 4.7x across trials; single-threshold transfer is weak
trend-level baseline, not a precision RUL model
FEMTO is an accelerated bearing testbed; factory motors need condition-specific data
scope: research similarity RUL on bearing vibration RMS trends
